payload.reason: The evidence provides specific information about the semantic tagset used, including its structure and purpose.

claims.text: The semantic tagset consists of 80 semantic tags grouped into 13 coarse-grained classes.
The semantic tags include distinctions such as negation, modals, types of quantification, and named entity types.
The semantic tagset is language-neutral and abstracts over part-of-speech and named-entity classes.
The tags include specific types like ART (artifacts), PER (persons), GEO (geographical entities), and ORG (organizations).
